summary: Utrecht University's NL Scholarship gives €5,000, €10,000 or €15,000 in the first year to non-EU students starting an international master's on 1 September 2027. Not every programme takes part. You apply in OSIRIS after applying for the master's, before 1 February at 23:59 CET.
meta_title: Utrecht University NL Scholarship 2027: up to €15,000
meta_description: Utrecht's NL Scholarship gives non-EU master's students €5,000, €10,000 or €15,000 in year one. Apply in OSIRIS before 1 February.
covers: €5,000, €10,000 or €15,000, paid in the first year, even on a two-year master's. It covers only part of the costs.
eligibility: No EU/EEA passport, and not eligible for Dutch student finance or statutory fees.
Never enrolled at a Dutch institution before, apart from exchange.
An application to a participating international master's starting on 1 September 2027. Check the programme's tuition and financial support page.
how_to_apply: Apply for an eligible master's at Utrecht.
In OSIRIS Online Application, open 'NL Scholarship' on your dashboard, click View/Edit, complete the form and submit it before 1 February at 23:59 CET.
Utrecht aims to publish the results by mid-April.
watch_out: You are assessed on your academic background, motivation and a financial plan (the Statement of Financial Resources) covering the whole programme.
Applications submitted from 27 January onwards cannot be corrected, so submit earlier.
The page gives the deadline as 1 February without a year; for September 2027 starts it falls on 1 February 2027.
documents: An application to a participating master's
The NL Scholarship form in OSIRIS

faq.q: How much is the Utrecht NL Scholarship?
faq.a: €5,000, €10,000 or €15,000, paid in the first year.
Before 1 February at 23:59 CET, for master's starting on 1 September 2027.

faq.q: Do all Utrecht master's take part?
faq.a: No. Check the tuition fees and financial support page of your programme.
